text:
jess: Kicking off account + VPC wireup for eu12 GPU landingpad. Need a minimal handoff runbook: project + billing, subnets, nat/egress, KMS, quotas. Short sync?

mike: ack. Do we have target CIDR range and VPC naming pattern?

jess: VPC CIDR: 10.140.0.0/16. Naming: r-eu12-gpu-vpc. We want separate subnets for compute/db/bastion across 3 AZs.

chen: For GPU nodes we should reserve /19 for compute to support growth (~8k IPs). Suggest compute subnets: /21 per AZ (3 AZs => /19). DB /22s, bastion /24 per AZ.

leah: FYI cloud quotas: region eu12 default GPU quota is 32 vGPUs. We'll need to open ticket for quota to 128 and request preemption-resistant nodes.

jess: Opened quota ticket: #INC-9123, ETA 48-72h. Adding request text: "Increase GPU quota in eu12 to 128, enable low-latency placement groups if possible."

mike: Network choices: Cloud NAT vs managed NAT gateways? Cost tradeoff: Cloud NAT cheaper for many ephemeral nodes. For Dedicated we may want NAT GW to control egress IPs. Thoughts?

chen: Cloud NAT -> simple + autoscaling. But we need static egress IPs for partner allowlists. Option: use NAT GW + egress proxy for partner flows.

leah: For KMS: create customer-managed key in eu12, policy to allow compute service account and infra team only. Use key rotation.

jess: Adding to runbook: KMS CMK ARN, service-account: r-eu12-infra-sa@redwood-prod. IAM roles: compute-runner, vpc-admin(ops).

infra-bot: terraform apply plan started on branch wip/eu12-wireup (PR #4207).

mike: Terraform specifics - recommend single module per account: vpc, subnets, gw, routes, firewall. Tagging: team:infra, env:prod, region:eu12, purpose:gpu.

chen: Snippet we used elsewhere:
```hcl
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/tf-modules//vpc"
  name   = "r-eu12-gpu-vpc"
  cidr   = "10.140.0.0/16"
}
```

leah: Security group rules: allow SSH from corp-bastion SG only; allow controller -> node health ports (_port:10250, 3000), allow node -> internet for images. No wide-open CIDR.

jess: Also enable flow logs to logging account, sample retention 30d, 1d ingest. Add route table entries for on-prem via VPN: 10.0.0.0/8 -> vpn-gw.

mike: Cost estimate rough: NAT GW per-AZ ~ $X/day, IP addresses, inter-AZ data egress. If we use Cloud NAT it's ~$Y/day. I'll plug numbers in cost sheet.

chen: Onboarding checklist for SRE handoff:
- project created + billing linked
- quotas bumped and confirmed
- VPC + subnets created 
- routes & VPN peer tested
- KMS key created and synced
- service accounts & IAM roles provisioned
- bastion deployed + key rotation
- smoke cluster deployed (1 GPU node)
- perf test (p95 token latency)

jess: For smoke cluster let's deploy a single p4d-equivalent instance in AZ-a then run kube e2e and a simple inference load test (small batch). Want to check kernel drivers & cuda versions.

infra-bot: smoke cluster job completed: instance p4d-sim-1 up, driver 515.43, cuda 12.1. Logs: /var/log/infra/eu12/smoke-2490001110.log

leah: Nice. Driver mismatch note: node shows cuda 12.1 but our runtime expects 11.x for current container. We should pin container or upgrade drivers.

mike: Action: create follow-up ticket to standardize runtime images to CUDA 12.x and update ci-builds. Assign to @chen.

chen: Taking it. I'll update image repo and roll out a new base image tag: r-base:cuda12-2026-03.

jess: Handoff to SRE: please verify scaling policy for Dedicated pool and autoscaler thresholds. We want warm nodes ~2 for hot starts.

sre-oncall: Will validate. Also note: alerting thresholds set for gpu-util > 90% and disk pressure on /dev/nvme*; adding runbooks for driver OOM and node reboots.

mike: Final checklist before handoff meeting: attach runbook doc (short), include terraform state location, show smoke test logs, quota ticket link, and cost estimate.

jess: Putting all artifacts in https://redwood.internal/projects/eu12/gpu-landingpad. Meeting 09:30 UTC tomorrow. If quotas don't come through we'll delay full roll.

leah: thumbs up :thumbsup: I'll prepare the KMS and identity docs.

chen: prepping PR to merge infra changes after one more review.

infra-bot: PR #4207 merged by mike. CI: passed.

jess: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene post-quota.

sre-oncall: leaving a note — verify egress allowlist for partner A (ip: 34.23.12.55) and add to NAT static IPs once NAT GW is provisioned.

mike: noted. I'll update the ticket.

jess: thread closed for now, will update with post-quota status.
